country.evidence_source: [/page/5/Text/7] The Swedish version of the TCI developed by Bra¨ndstro¨m et al. (1998, 2001, 2003, 2008) was used in the present study.

Outcome_variable.evidence_source: [/page/5/Text/7] The Temperament and Character Inventory (TCI) measures the seven factors of the psychobiological model of personality (238-items with forced binary answer: yes or no). The four temperament dimensions are: Harm Avoidance, Novelty Seeking, Reward Dependence, and Persistence. The three character dimensions are: Self-Directedness, Cooperativeness, and Self-Transcendence.
Outcome_variable.warning: The TCI measures personality traits, not subjective well-being components (life satisfaction, positive affect, negative affect).
